note: Hand-curated from the npm registry 'time' map (release times) and OSV/GHSA records (advisory publish times), checked 2026-10-07. Bad versions were unpublished by npm, so their manifests are reconstructed from the advisory and cited; everything else in data/ is recorded.

incidents.title: event-stream handed to a new maintainer who added flatmap-stream
incidents.expectEarlyWarning: event-stream 3.3.5 was the first release by right9ctrl (2018-09-05), 82 days before the advisory

incidents.title: ua-parser-js maintainer account hijacked; cryptominer and password stealer in preinstall
incidents.expectEarlyWarning: new preinstall script in a package that never had one

incidents.title: coa and rc hijacked the same day, same malware as ua-parser-js
incidents.expectEarlyWarning: dormant package (no release for ~3 years) releases with a new preinstall script

incidents.title: node-ipc maintainer ships protestware that wipes files in Russia/Belarus (10.1.x) and peacenotwar (9.2.2)
incidents.expectEarlyWarning: a patch release (9.2.2) adds a brand-new dependency (peacenotwar) published by the same account the same day

incidents.title: qix maintainer account phished; crypto-stealing code in chalk, debug and 16 more
incidents.expectEarlyWarning: chalk 5.6.1 was published by qix, not by the account that published the previous release (sindresorhus); debug: none (same publisher) — caught by the advisory

incidents.title: phished npm token; Windows malware in an install script
incidents.expectEarlyWarning: new install script; earlier 10.x releases carried npm provenance, the bad ones did not

incidents.title: s1ngularity: stolen npm token, nx releases steal secrets via AI CLIs
incidents.expectEarlyWarning: earlier nx releases carried npm provenance attestations; the bad ones did not
